column1: # Cited .text addresses that are not a function entry and not inside any listed body.
# It was published into the kit 2026-09-14 from Tools/work/OPUS/seed_text_tables.py.
# DO NOT RE-SEED. The `verdict` and `why` columns below were written by hand; the seeder
# rewrites this file from the address scan and would discard both. gen_doc_claim_terms.py
# did exactly that to a sibling file on 2026-09-14 - 85 lines to 63, 22 adjudicated rows
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. FINAL-AUDIT pass 1 fails if a cited address 'is not a function
# (or is cited as one and is data)'. verify_doc_addresses already grants that jump and
# PSM tables after a function are legitimate and asks for confirmation IN CONTEXT - but
# the context is spread over 91 pages and nothing records a confirmation once it is made,
# so the same 250 addresses are re-read at every audit. One registry, confirmed once.
# EVERY ROW IS UNCONFIRMED. This file seeds the evidence; it decides nothing. Set verdict
# to TABLE (a jump/PSM/dispatch table belonging to prev_fn), UNLISTED (a body the function
# list does not contain - see UC-1), PAD, or DEFECT (cited as a function and is not one),
# prev_fn_indirect_jmp = the preceding body contains an FF /4 indirect jmp, which is what a
# jump-table user looks like. It is a HINT, not a verdict: it says the shape is available,
# not that this address is that table.
# That tool was published into the kit 2026-09-14 from Tools/work/OPUS/classify_text_gaps.py,
# and it edits this file IN PLACE.
# 170 of 250 decided with the evidence in `why`; 80 deliberately left UNCONFIRMED.
#   TABLE 147 - any of: four or more of the first eight dwords resolving as image-base+rel32 into
#               prev_fn's own body while prev_fn carries an indirect jmp; the address falling inside
#               the dispatch table whose location was READ OUT of prev_fn's own indexing code
#               (`lea base` + `mov eax,[base + idx*4 + disp]`); the same dword test after skipping an
#               alignment nop (00366636 is `66 90` and its table starts two bytes in); or a run of 16+
#               small byte indices beside an indirect jmp - the index half of a two-level dense
#               switch (00306D08 is `00 01 06 06 06 ...`); or the address falling inside a TWO-LEVEL
#               dense switch's table region, read whole from the dispatching code - `movzx eax,
#               byte [base+idx+d1]` gives a byte index table and `mov ecx, dword [base+idx*4+d2]` a
#               dword target table, and the dword table is NOT bound+1 entries long (it holds one
#               entry per DISTINCT target), so sizing it that way runs it straight through the byte
#   PAD    19 - int3/nop/zero filler whose run reaches the next listed body.
#   UNLISTED 4 - decodes from the address as a real body: a callee-saved push, an rsp frame set up,
#               a shadow-space spill running to a ret; or a 5-byte `jmp rel32` followed by filler,
#               which is a tail-call forwarder body the list does not contain.
# THE 81 ARE NOT A BUCKET, and 71 of them are ONE QUESTION ALREADY UNDER REVIEW. Every rule above is
# a SUFFICIENT condition, so anything meeting none stays UNCONFIRMED for a person. Of the 81:
#   71  the gap holds a contiguous run of real instructions but the CITED address is not its start -
#       among them 7 whose nearest listed predecessor 00133B40 is 127 bytes long and whose gap to the
#       next listed body is over 80 KB: a large unlisted region (libvpx SIMD kernels), not a table.
#       SIMD kernels with no frame, or an interior point of a body. Whether such a body is admitted
#       is exactly OPUS-UC1-POPULATION-CHANGE, which is BLOCKED on SWE2-AUDIT-SPEC's review of the
#       34,409 floor. Deciding them here would pre-empt that review.
#   17  (overlapping) prev_fn carries an indirect jmp whose table this reader could not locate - a
#       second table form, not an absence of one.
#    4  begin with filler whose run does NOT reach the next body - a zeroed or padded region rather
# A VERDICT WITH NO EVIDENCE IS WORTH LESS THAN NO VERDICT, which is why this file was seeded rather
# than filled. An earlier pass of mine accepted any leading `mov` as a prologue and produced 38
# UNLISTED, of which 36 were mid-function code - `mov r10,[rsp+0x28]` is a body reading its fifth
# argument. Columns 1-8 are untouched by this pass.
# POPULATION RE-MEASURED 2026-09-14 (OPUS). The filename's 250 is the SEED COUNT, not a
# live total: the corpus now cites 261 of these addresses, 0 of the original 250 are no
# longer cited, and 11 were cited with no row at all and are appended here as UNCONFIRMED.
# That is newly discovered debt, not a regression - no verdict here was wrong, and rows for
# addresses no longer cited are KEPT because deleting an adjudication that nothing
# currently needs is how the same work gets done twice.
# The file is NOT renamed: AUDIT-LOG.md and TEAM.json reference it by this name and both
# are append-only records of what was true when written.
# reasonless UNCONFIRMED rows were read against the image: 3 PAD (cited at filler before
# an unlisted body: 0012A50C, 0012C02C, 003594BE), 2 UNLISTED (003594C0 a 27-B byte
# select-and-store; 007EE7C0 a multi-case [rcx+0x138] step with two rets), and the other
# 58 confirmed as interior points of contiguous instruction runs - the UC-1-deferred
# class, each now carrying that reason. No DEFECT row was found: nothing cited as a
# function proved not to be one. Verdicts: 153 TABLE, 24 PAD, 6 UNLISTED, 78 UNCONFIRMED
# (all reasoned; the residual is one population question, not 78 separate ones).
# THIRD PASS 2026-09-15 (SWE2-FRONTIER, same claim). The prev_fn bodies of the
# 'indirect jmp, table not located' rows were disassembled and the tables READ OUT of
# the indexing code; every cited run-start was re-decoded against the image. 24 rows
#   TABLE 2 - 0028144C is the dword target table of 00280DE0's second two-level switch
#             (its code reads [rbp+rax*4+0x16144c] with rbp=image base); 002FE5B0 is the
#             byte index table of 002FDDA0's second switch ([r9+rax+0x1de5b0]).
#   UNLISTED 22 - cited address is the START of a bounded body (ret/int3 on both sides,
#             decodes to ret): four tail-forwarders (0025D9C0, 002697F0, 004223F0 - the
#             stated jmp-rel32 shape - and leaf 0026AF70/006DF3A0/003DE3E0 setters), the
#   Interior-point reasons sharpened where the containing body is now known: the
#   002FE7xx rows are interior of unlisted body 002FE7D0; the 0055B3xx rows interior of
#   unlisted body 0055B310; 005806CC/005807AC are interior code - 0057FE80's two jump
#   tables were located at 005807B8 and 00580800, not at the cited addresses.
#   Verdicts: 155 TABLE, 24 PAD, 28 UNLISTED, 56 UNCONFIRMED (all reasoned; the residual
#   is still one population question - UC-1 - not 56 separate ones).
